note.note:
I’m ready to generate the SOAP note, but I need the actual content.

Please provide:
- The full transcript text (doctor-patient conversation) in place of {transcript}
- The Differential Diagnosis (DDx) in JSON in place of {ddx}

Once I have those, I will produce a concise, professional SOAP note with:
- Subjective: presenting complaint, onset/duration/progression, PMH, medications, social history, allergies
- Objective: exam findings and any documented investigations (if present)
- Assessment & Plan: one or more issues, with:
  - Likely diagnosis (name)
  - DDx (only if consistent with transcript; note conflict if applicable)
  - Investigations planned
  - Treatments planned
  - Referrals (if applicable)
- Quality checks: note any missing elements, conflicts between transcript and DDx (mark “conflict noted”), and transcript quality notes if relevant

Formatting will follow American English, concise bullet points, and the exact structure you provided.
